events.name: chat.reply_fragment
events.description: Chunk of the assistant reply (deterministic word-boundary chunks, AGENT_REPLY_CHUNK_WORDS).

events.name: chat.tool_activity
events.description: Tool executed (status success/failure); no payload content.

events.name: chat.interrupt_waiting
events.description: Human-in-the-loop: the run waits for an explicit decision on a proposal.

events.name: chat.run_completed
events.description: Turn finished and the assistant message was persisted.

events.name: chat.run_failed
events.description: Turn failed with a typed error code.

description: SSE wire contract of the chat streaming surface (R-07). The client dedupes by (run_id, id); reconnect resumes via POST /resume with the same run claim (0 parallel runs, 0 duplicated effects).
